title.zh: 修好 Safari 上的导出与主奏
title.en: Safari: exports and the lead, fixed

highlights.zh: Safari 离线渲染时听不到合成引擎，导出的文件只剩鼓和贝斯，分轨里的和弦与主奏是空的。现在会自动改用原生音色，导出内容完整。
highlights.en: Safari could not hear the synth engine when rendering offline, so exports kept only the drums and bass, and the chords/lead stems were empty. Those lanes now use the native engine.

highlights.zh: 播放时主奏的音准以前是单独发的，会在错误的时刻改到正在响的音；现在跟着音符一起、在音符自己的时刻生效。
highlights.en: The lead's tuning used to arrive as a separate message that retuned whatever was already sounding; it now travels with the note and takes effect at the note's own moment.

title.zh: 维护版：补上织体音色的后备音色，更新记录只保留最近十条
title.en: Maintenance: a fallback voice for the texture instruments, and the changelog keeps the latest ten

highlights.zh: 修掉一处隐患：采样织体音色在关闭新合成引擎时没有后备音色，会掉到一个没人选过的默认音色。
highlights.en: Fixed a gap: a sample-texture instrument had no fallback voice with the new synth engine switched off, and fell through to a default nobody chose.

highlights.zh: 这一版没有可听的变化。
highlights.en: Nothing in this release changes what you hear.

title.zh: 导出的循环可以无缝衔接；两处测量更可靠
title.en: Exported loops join themselves; two measurements made more reliable

highlights.zh: 新增无缝循环导出：渲染的尾巴折回开头，循环重复时不会再出现一段空白再从头开始。
highlights.en: New seamless-loop export: the render's tail folds back over the start, so a repeated loop no longer rings out into silence and restarts.

highlights.zh: 宽度预算按两次相同测量收紧；会听声音的编排探针改为按每遍取中位数，不再把机器卡顿误判成混音问题。
highlights.en: The width budget was tightened after two matching measurements, and the arrangement probe now takes the median per pass instead of reading a stalled machine as a mix problem.

title.zh: 26 个曲风的唱针噪声改用采样；两对过于相似的曲风各自换了编制
title.en: 26 genres' needle noise now plays a recording; two pairs of near-identical genres were given their own palettes

highlights.zh: 26 个曲风（lofi-hip-hop、trip-hop、boom-bap、爵士与布鲁斯各支、motown、neo-soul 等）本来就写着「黑胶爆豆声」，现在这一轨播的是采样，不再用合成噪声顶替。
highlights.en: 26 genres already declared a vinyl crackle — lofi-hip-hop, trip-hop, boom-bap, the jazz and blues genres, motown, neo-soul and others — and that lane now plays a recording instead of synthesised noise.

highlights.zh: 全库音色测量发现两对曲风几乎一模一样，已给它们各自应有的编制；电平随之重新对齐。
highlights.en: A full-library timbre measurement found two pairs of genres that rendered almost identically; each was given the palette its name implies, and the levels were re-matched.

title.zh: 和弦与主奏的每个音符有了细微音准差异
title.en: Every note on chords and lead now carries a slight tuning difference

highlights.zh: 合成引擎升级：和弦与主奏轨的每个音符带一点音准偏移，同一个和弦不再像同一个音的复制。
highlights.en: The synth engine was upgraded: each note on the chords and lead tracks carries a small tuning offset, so a chord no longer sounds like copies of one note.

highlights.zh: 同时打通了采样播放的准备（导入、音色、路由），为后续的采样织体铺路。
highlights.en: The groundwork for sample playback also landed — import, patch and routing — ahead of sample-based texture.

title.zh: 手机换歌不再一步一首；母带不再吃掉侧链与渐强；立体声更宽
title.en: Phone playback waits for a track; the master stops eating ducks and builds; wider stereo

highlights.zh: 手机播放顺序修好：会等一首放完再换，一首的时长从几秒的循环变成约 80 秒的编排。
highlights.en: The phone's play-order button works: it waits for a track to finish, and a track is now the arrangement (about 80 seconds) instead of a few seconds of loop.

highlights.zh: 母带链不再把编排写进去的侧链下潜和渐强还回来；整体立体声更宽，鼓、贝斯、军鼓仍在中间。
highlights.en: The master chain no longer gives back the sidechain dips and builds the arrangement writes; the mix is wider, with kick, bass and snare still centred.

highlights.zh: 工作台的走带开始真正播放编排，而不只是在循环。
highlights.en: The studio's transport now plays the arrangement rather than looping one pattern.

title.zh: 皮肤收口：桌面与手机共用一张颜色角色表，卡顿预算收紧
title.en: Skins: desktop and phone share one colour-role table, and the jank budget is tightened

highlights.zh: 桌面与手机改为共用同一张「颜色值 → 角色」表；第一次运行就找出 39 处不一致，逐条记录为有意保留的偏差。
highlights.en: Desktop and phone now share one value-to-role table; its first run found 39 disagreements, each recorded as a deliberate deviation with its reason.

highlights.zh: 手机的即兴垫颜色改由皮肤提供，不再写死在代码里。
highlights.en: The phone's jam pads take their colours from the skin instead of a hard-coded list.

highlights.zh: 卡顿探针的余量从约 50% 收到约 35%，并开始报告自己的余量。
highlights.en: The jank probe's headroom came down from about 50% to about 35%, and it now reports that headroom.

title.zh: 皮肤修正：悬停色曾被当成基础色，133 条规则受影响
title.en: Skins: hover colours were being applied as base colours, across 133 rules

highlights.zh: 生成的选择器漏掉了悬停状态，133 条悬停规则被当成普通样式一直生效，已修正。
highlights.en: The generated selectors dropped the hover state, so 133 hover rules applied all the time; that is fixed.

highlights.zh: 低对比门禁归零：五个视图原本是 8/130/3/6/6，现在全部为 0。
highlights.en: The low-contrast gate is at zero: five views that read 8/130/3/6/6 now all read 0.

title.zh: 加入歌曲模型（片段与段落），手机明确为功能子集，音质改进变成可检查的门禁
title.en: A song model (clips and sections), the phone declared a subset, and sound quality turned into gates

highlights.zh: 歌曲由片段与段落组成（A/B 槽位、重复小节数、逐段静音与力度），导出与手机播放都基于它。
highlights.en: A song is now clips and sections — A/B slots, a bar count per section, per-section mute and velocity — and both the export and phone playback are built on it.

highlights.zh: 新增曲风质量门禁：用应用自己的引擎渲染曲风样本，逐条检查力度、侧链、声场、中频与和声等指标。
highlights.en: A genre-quality gate renders sample genres through the app's own engine and checks velocity spread, sidechain, stereo field, mid range and harmony.

highlights.zh: 手机的能力写成明确清单：哪一项没有、为什么没有，都有记录。
highlights.en: What the phone can do is now an explicit list, with a reason recorded for everything it does not have.

title.zh: 皮肤对比度修正：装饰不再被当成底色，和弦页低对比从 129 降到 5
title.en: Skin contrast: decoration is no longer read as a background, and the chords view drops from 129 to 5

highlights.zh: 对比度审计把渐变与网点当成了文字背后的颜色，造成大量误判，已修正。
highlights.en: The contrast audit treated gradients and halftone dots as the colour behind text, which produced false failures; that is fixed.

highlights.zh: 灰阶 500 档此前被静默跳过，生成的选择器匹配不到任何元素，现已归位。
highlights.en: The 500 step of the grey scale was silently skipped, so its selector matched nothing; it now works.

highlights.zh: 和弦页低对比从 129 处降到 5 处，两个手机视图降到 0。
highlights.en: The chords view went from 129 low-contrast cases to 5, and two phone views to 0.
